_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values. local.settings.json is gitignored.

Values._comment_storage: Identity-only storage auth. Set the two __serviceUri keys (not a connection string) and grant your local AAD user 'Storage Blob Data Contributor' + 'Storage Queue Data Contributor' on the account; the Functions host hits storage via DefaultAzureCredential. In Azure these come from the Function App's Managed Identity. AZURE_FUNCTIONS_ENVIRONMENT=Development tells our client wiring to skip the IMDS probe locally.
Values._comment_tracking: Endpoint hit by DefaultAzureCredential for the tracking blob. Same storage account as the queue + AzureWebJobsStorage so a single identity grant covers everything.
Values._comment_deadletter: Storage Queue buffers failed records before they're written to the Dataverse error table. The QueueTrigger listener for DeadLetterProcessor reads from AzureWebJobsStorage (identity-bound), so the queue must live on the SAME storage account the __queueServiceUri above points to. DeadLetterMaxAttempts is NOT set here — Program.cs reads extensions.queues.maxDequeueCount from host.json so the two can't drift.
Values._comment_failureblob: When all queue retries are exhausted, one blob per record is archived under errors/yyyy/MM/dd/{invocationId}-{key}.json. Same storage account as the queue.
Values._comment_disable: Set to 'true' to disable the DeadLetterProcessor QueueTrigger function. Use when the queue doesn't exist yet or storage RBAC is being sorted — a failed listener startup otherwise kills the entire host (incl. the TimerTrigger).
Values._comment_appinsights: Optional. When unset the app runs fine and telemetry is discarded. Set it to start seeing traces/dependencies/exceptions in the Application Insights resource. Format: InstrumentationKey=<guid>;IngestionEndpoint=https://<region>.applicationinsights.azure.com/;...
